# Granularity ablation: compare RF classification across different label granularities.

- binary 设置: d0 vs {d1,d2,d3} (标签 0 vs 1)
- 3-class: 仅保留 d1/d2/d3 样本
- 4-class: 使用所有 d0-d3
- 6-class: 使用所有 d0-d5 (仅 Pythia nucleus)
- 对每个设置计算 adjacent-pair AUC (如 4-class 的 d0v1/d1v2/d2v3, 6-class 的 d0v1/.../d4v5)
